community_list_entries.name: TReMu: Towards Neuro-Symbolic Temporal Reasoning for LLM-Agents with Memory in Multi-Session Dialogues

phase1_classification.kind_reason: The paper contributes both a framework and a new temporal-reasoning benchmark: 600 multiple-choice QAs (112 unanswerable) built by augmenting LoCoMo multi-session dialogues. The paper only says the data 'will be released', gives no URL, and a GitHub search found no repo.
